summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new Purchasing module (Suppliers, PO, Payment, Receive, Price History, Stats). 20/20 backend pytest passed. UI flows verified: nav → stats/tabs → create supplier → create PO → partial pay (SEBAGIAN) → receive (DITERIMA + stock+price updated on Inventory) → history tab with expand + change_pct + trend icon → delete PO with stock rollback.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> inserted as child of <option> for materials/suppliers selects. Not user-facing but pollutes console. Root cause appears to be the emergent devtool wrapping option children in dynamic <span data-ve-dynamic>. Consider inspecting devtool integration.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line ~4288 po_pay: uses Dict[str, Any] Body(...) instead of a Pydantic model. Consider PayPOIn(BaseModel) for validation consistency with rest of module.

server.py po_delete rollback ignores payment_status — after rolling back stock, the payment amount remains recorded in stats via total. Since PO is deleted, this is fine, but note: if a partial payment was recorded then the PO deleted with rollback, the payment history is lost (no ledger entry). Consider a payments audit log collection for future finance tracing.
purchasing/suppliers PUT — no duplicate-name protection on rename (unlike POST). If user renames supplier A to an existing supplier B's name, no 400 is returned. Should reuse the duplicate check.
_enrich_po uses async for over db.materials.find — for large material catalogs this is fine; but the {m['id']: m async for ...} builds full dict per list request. Cache-friendly, low priority.
Frontend Purchasing.jsx (700+ lines) — approaching the recommended 700-line limit; consider extracting POTab, SuppliersTab, PriceHistoryTab into separate files for maintainability.
server.py po_receive: idempotent guard only checks status. If someone toggles status manually in DB then re-receives, could double stock. Acceptable given super_admin scope.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (nav, stats, create supplier, create PO, partial pay, receive, stock+price update, price history, expand history, delete PO with rollback)

seed_data_creation: Test-created supplier (TEST_Sup_*), test material (TEST_MAT_*) and their PO chains were auto-cleaned by pytest teardown and post-run cleanup script. Existing seed PO-202607-0001 / PT Sumber Print preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Purchasing module verified end-to-end. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_purchasing.py — reusable regression suite covering supplier CRUD (dup detect, empty name, soft/hard delete), PO create (validation, auto po_no, subtotal+tax+total math), pay (partial/lunas/negative-reject), receive (stock update + price update + idempotent), cancel (reject when diterima), price history grouping+aggregates, stats, and delete with stock rollback. Frontend flows work; only cosmetic devtool-injected hydration warnings on <option> selects (not blocking).
